layout_estimate_scope: Arial 16 px summed glyph advances; fallback-run screen fit still needs live confirmation. Full settings paragraph wrapping is unchanged.
fragment_meaning_decisions: A setting/default/beginner sentence must not acquire a noun from the preceding English line.
Keep the 15-/12-inning maximum in the same source fragment as the tied-game condition.
Preserve the distinction between hold time, stronger throws and more accurate throws.
Keep baserunning automation separate from user-controlled steals.
Pitch marker and strike-zone fragments must retain their complete location or hot/cold-zone meaning.
Reconstruct a split rundown or settings word from its actual parent, without globally translating an isolated word ending.
Direction-pad and left-stick runs retain the nouns surrounding the native controller icons.
Generic names-only and no-skip fragments avoid importing a fielder or catcher noun absent from their own source.
